findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to these invariant-specialized lemmas, matching `mem_coinvariants`, `mapCoinvariants_coe_apply`, and `mapCoinvariants_comp`.
findings.issue: `mem_invariants`, `Hom.mapInvariants_coe_apply`, and `Hom.mapInvariants_comp` are public characteristic lemmas for the invariant API but lack `@[simp]`, so users do not get the same normal forms as for the generic coinvariant API.
